shape.situation_pattern: An operator shell side comment conflicts with the assumptions baked into a proposed paste (e.g. wrong working directory).
shape.decision: Adjust to the actual shell and directory reality before instructing; log the mismatch rather than blindly re-pasting.
shape.reasoning_physics: Instructing on a wrong default (Windows path, wrong repo) repeats the failure; correcting the input context once beats teaching a bad recipe twice.
